create_redis_cluster_cache: create a RedisClusterCache instance to cache LLM responses using a Redis Cluster backend
init_async_redis_client: initialize the async Redis Cluster client for non-blocking cache operations
run_redis_mget_operation: run a Redis mget operation to fetch multiple cached values by keys from the cluster
async_run_redis_mget_operation: async run a Redis mget operation to fetch multiple cached values by keys from the cluster
test_redis_cluster_connection: test the Redis Cluster connection by pinging the cluster and verifying connectivity
